summary: Sketch drags are now answered by the app's own native solver, so dragging no longer loads PlaneGCS. A drag becomes two temporary value relations on the dragged point, after the sketch's relations. Native answers a drag whose target was reached or projected (nothing closer found from the start) when the result is converged, fully diagnosed and passes the graph checks, as for any other solve; a drag that stalls is not converged, and PlaneGCS is asked instead, the stalled rejection standing when PlaneGCS does no better. PlaneGCS also still answers drags whose rank native cannot yet diagnose, such as some nearly straight arms stretched beyond their reach. A drag moves its point's groups on purpose, so they are never kept at their start values, and a reached target is kept exactly. For the die, from medians of interleaved Node runs at about 65 to 75 ms of calibration, a drag falls from about 1.73 to 1.53 ms, and the first drag after native solves from about 19 to 6.2 ms because PlaneGCS is no longer loaded for it. PlaneGCS still loads for the solves native cannot answer.
warning: No breaking change for installed posts, machine packages, saved revisions, CAD files or controller output. Dragged geometry can differ from PlaneGCS's in the last digits, and where a target cannot be reached the point stops at the nearest place native finds from the start, which on the sketches compared is never further from the target than PlaneGCS's. A drag that neither solver can move is rejected with the message that the point could not be moved toward the target from this start.

checklist.schema: No UPID, post, machine package, execution plan, saved revision, CAD, storage, journal, worker reply or native buffer protocol schema change. Post engine API remains 1 and saved-job engine remains 3.
checklist.events: No execution event, cancellation or input-version behavior change. WebMCP tools keep their arguments and result fields.
checklist.capabilities: No post or machine capability change and no new application controls.
checklist.auditAndOutput: No generation, audit, numbering, encoding, line ending, feed or controller-file change.
checklist.installationAndStorage: No installed package, revision, browser-cache or folder storage change.
checklist.verification: Runtime tests cover solves and drags answered natively without loading PlaneGCS, a reached drag target kept exactly however little it moved, a two-link arm dragged out of reach and back, chained and from the start, reached natively within reach and ending as close to its targets as PlaneGCS beyond it, where PlaneGCS answers the stretched frames native cannot diagnose, and a stalled drag rejected as not moved unless PlaneGCS solves it. Compilation tests cover the two temporary value equations after the relations and reject a missing point, a coordinate beyond 1e9 mm and a non-finite target. The native-differential project now compares drags too: every native drag must end within max(1e-6, 64 epsilon S) mm of PlaneGCS's distance to its target; across the suites 27 drags were compared directly and 24 answered by the runtime, none stalled, and none ended further than PlaneGCS beyond that allowance. Timings are medians of three interleaved sets of 40 runs and seven cold probes in fresh processes.

publicNotes.summary: Drags sketches with the app's own solver.
changes: Answers sketch drags with the app's own solver, so the first drag starts sooner and later drags are slightly faster.
publicNotes.compatibility: Installed machine packages, posts, saved revisions, CAD files and controller output are unchanged.
